name: Counting and ordering
description: Counting names how many there are, and each number is one more than the one before it.

name: Place value
description: A digit's value depends on its place: ones, tens, hundreds, thousands.

name: Adding whole numbers
description: Adding combines amounts; line up the places and carry when a column passes 9.

name: Subtracting whole numbers
description: Subtracting finds what is left or the difference; borrow from the next place when needed.

name: Multiplication facts
description: Multiplication is repeated addition: 6 × 7 means seven sixes added together.

name: Division facts
description: Division splits into equal groups and undoes multiplication: if 6 × 7 = 42 then 42 ÷ 7 = 6.

name: Multi-digit multiplication
description: Break a number by place value, multiply each part, then add the partial products.

name: Long division
description: Divide one place at a time from the left, multiply back, subtract, and bring down the next digit.

name: Factors and multiples
description: A factor divides a number exactly; a multiple is what you get by multiplying it.

name: Prime numbers
description: A prime has exactly two factors, 1 and itself.

name: Order of operations
description: Brackets first, then multiplication and division, then addition and subtraction.

name: Negative numbers
description: Negative numbers sit below zero on the number line; the further left, the smaller.

name: Integer operations
description: Same signs multiply to a positive; different signs multiply to a negative.

name: Exponents
description: An exponent says how many times to multiply the base by itself.

name: What a fraction means
description: A fraction a/b means a of b equal parts of a whole.

name: Equivalent fractions
description: Multiply or divide top and bottom by the same number and the fraction keeps its value.

name: Comparing fractions
description: With the same top, the fraction with the smaller bottom is bigger because its parts are larger.

name: Adding fractions with the same denominator
description: Same-sized parts add by adding the tops and keeping the bottom.

name: Adding fractions with different denominators
description: First rewrite both fractions with a common denominator, then add the tops.

name: Mixed numbers and improper fractions
description: A mixed number is a whole plus a fraction; multiply the whole by the bottom and add the top to make an improper fraction.

name: Multiplying fractions
description: Multiply the tops together and the bottoms together, then simplify.

name: Dividing fractions
description: Dividing by a fraction means multiplying by its reciprocal (flip it).

name: Decimal place value
description: Places after the point are tenths, hundredths, thousandths, each ten times smaller.

name: Adding and multiplying decimals
description: Line up the decimal points to add; to multiply, ignore the points then place the point by counting decimal places.

name: Fractions as decimals
description: A fraction is a division: divide the top by the bottom to get the decimal.

name: What a percent means
description: Percent means out of 100, so 45% is 45/100 or 0.45.

name: Finding a percent of a number
description: Turn the percent into a decimal or fraction and multiply.

name: Percent change
description: Percent change is the change divided by the original value, times 100.

name: Ratios
description: A ratio compares two quantities in a fixed order, written a:b.

name: Unit rates
description: A unit rate is the amount for one unit; divide the total by the number of units.

name: Proportions
description: Two ratios are in proportion when they are equivalent; scale both parts by the same factor.

name: Variables and expressions
description: A letter stands for an unknown or changing number; 5n means 5 times n.

name: Evaluating expressions
description: Substitute the value for the letter, then follow the order of operations.

name: Combining like terms
description: Only terms with the same letter part can be added: 3x + 2x = 5x, but 3x + 2y stays as it is.

name: One-step equations
description: Do the same operation to both sides to get the letter alone.

name: Two-step equations
description: Undo the adding or subtracting first, then undo the multiplying or dividing.

name: The coordinate plane
description: A point (x, y) is x across and y up from the origin; x always comes first.

name: Slope
description: Slope is rise over run: how far up for each step across.

name: Lines: y = mx + b
description: In y = mx + b, m is the slope and b is where the line crosses the y-axis.

name: Perimeter
description: Perimeter is the distance around a shape: add all the side lengths.

name: Area of rectangles
description: Area is the space inside a shape; for a rectangle multiply length by width.

name: Area of triangles
description: A triangle is half of a rectangle with the same base and height: area = base × height ÷ 2.

name: Angles in a triangle
description: The three angles of any triangle add up to 180°.

name: Pythagoras' theorem
description: In a right triangle, a² + b² = c² where c is the longest side.

name: Mean
description: The mean is the total divided by how many values there are.

name: Median
description: The median is the middle value once the numbers are in order.

name: Basic probability
description: Probability is favourable outcomes over all equally likely outcomes.
